verdict.rationale: A government company-registry portal could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or chatbot, so this axis applies. The evidence pack holds only two probes that hit HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, and nothing documents any natural-language command interface. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
